        self.assertEqual(export_csv(rows, columns), expected)

        expected = 'a,b,c\\r\\nhello\\nworld,world,!\\r\\n'

        expected = 'a,b,c\\r\\nhello\\"world,world,!\\r\\n'
        self.assertEqual(export_csv(rows, columns), expected)

        rows = [{'a': 'hello\\world', 'b': 'world', 'c': '!'}]
        expected = 'a,b,c\\r\\nhello\\\\world,world,!\\r\\n'
        self.assertEqual(export_csv(rows, columns), expected)

        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            export_csv(rows, ['a', 'a'])

if __name__ == '__main__':
